_what: Which Kokoro voice speaks each surface of the practice site.
_why: Owner decisions: (1) ship Kokoro site-wide to eliminate the browser's robotic speechSynthesis, (2) use a MIX of voices so it feels like a team of teachers rather than one voice, (3) AMERICAN ACCENT ONLY — this is an American-English programme, no British voices anywhere.
_rule: Every voice id must start with af_ (American female) or am_ (American male). bf_/bm_ (British) are FORBIDDEN and validate_cast() fails the build if any appears.

index.role: Host — opens each day, friendly and welcoming

accent.role: Pronunciation model — the clearest, most neutral American voice, the one students imitate

shadowing.role: Main narrator — the passage students shadow

vocab.role: Vocabulary coach — crisp, clear single words

reading.role: Storyteller — narrates reading passages with energy

mediation.role: Explainer — relays and simplifies (reuses the clear neutral male)

listening_rotation._note: Listening comprehension needs DIFFERENT PEOPLE, not one voice. Listening items rotate deterministically across this set (by item index) so a student practises understanding several American speakers, male and female.
